source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Clearly identify the product and its specifications.
3. Verify the testing conditions against the advertised conditions.
4. Record all observations and measurements meticulously.
5. Compare actual performance data with advertised specifications.
6. Record discrepancies quantitatively with deviations.
7. Consolidate data into a clear and concise report.
8. Provide comprehensive commentary explaining discrepancies.
9. Back up your findings with documented evidence.
10. Include details of the testing environment and equipment.
11. Use the appropriate data presentation tools (graphs, charts, etc.).
12. Mention the product batch number, serial number for traceability.
13. Avoid personal opinions and bias – stick to the facts.
14. Document any external factors that could have impacted the test results.
15. Ensure data integrity; a third-party review might be necessary.
16. Cite any industry standards or regulations that were referenced.
17. Review the report for clarity, accuracy, and completeness.
